prompts.hair:
Edit target / identity reference: the attached original pixel-art red-haired forest girl.
Create a professional CUTOUT ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of ONLY HER ORANGE HAIR + WHITE FLOWER for ONE VERTICAL JUMP.
Six distinct drawings in EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, read left to right. True transparent background. No text, labels, grid or shadows. Keep original chunky pixel size, plum outline, orange palette, flower and overall volume. Remove face, ears, eyes, skin and all body/clothing; leave a transparent face opening.
SAME SCALE AND SAME SKULL/CROWN POSITION in each cell. Hair roots and face opening are a stable attachment to the head. Only free locks respond to movement. Generous padding above and below for airflow changes; never clip hair tips.
1 top-left APPUI / ANTICIPATION: slight forward-set fringe, long locks resting loosely to the sides, ready to jump.
2 top-middle ASCENT: character accelerates UP; long locks STREAM STRAIGHT DOWN noticeably, narrow vertical silhouette, tips hang below the absent shoulders, flower roots stay fixed.
3 top-right APEX: upward speed reaches zero, locks spread outward horizontally and begin curling up, a clear intermediate transition between down and up.
4 bottom-left FALL: character moves DOWN; long locks STREAM UP strongly beside and ABOVE the crown, free ends pointing skyward, face opening unchanged.
5 bottom-middle FALL WIND A: still UPWARD streaming, tips ripple to the LEFT, strong readable wind variation.
6 bottom-right FALL WIND B: still UPWARD streaming, tips ripple to the RIGHT, strong readable alternate wind variation.
Do NOT make six similar resting hairstyles. Ascent must have tips DOWN; all bottom-row fall poses must have tips UP. Hand-drawn consistent pixel-art frames, not rotations or warped duplicates. Keep the exact source character hairstyle and flower. This is one isolated hair layer to composite over a separate head.
prompts.torso:
Edit target / identity reference: attached original pixel-art forest girl. Produce ONLY HER TORSO WITH BOTH WHOLE ARMS AND HANDS as a six-frame JUMP sprite sheet. EXACTLY 3 columns x2 rows, no labels, grid, text, glow or backdrop; true transparent background. Exclude head, hair, cape, skirt, waist pouch, belt and legs. Same green tunic, white short puff sleeves, brown diagonal leather strap, brown forearm bracers, peach hands and dark plum outlines. Keep original chunky square pixel density and exact costume, three-quarter facing RIGHT.
SAME torso dimensions, neck attachment position and waist attachment position in all six cells. Room above shoulders for raised arms. Chest stays facing three-quarter right, never show the back. Only arms and slight torso posture change, not character scale.
TOP ROW 1 APPUI: torso slightly leaning forward, elbows bent back, both hands behind/down preparing an upward push.
2 ASCENT: chest upright, arms swept DOWN and BACK close to sides after takeoff.
3 APEX: chest balanced, elbows partly bent and arms spreading OUT to either side, hands about chest height, transition toward falling.
BOTTOM ROW 4 FALL: both arms lifted UP, elbows bent, hands ABOVE shoulder height, reacting to falling.
5 FALL WIND LEFT: keep same raised arms and same torso, slight variation in hand/elbow angles.
6 FALL WIND RIGHT: keep same raised arms with alternate small elbow/hand variation.
Make these six clearly DIFFERENT DRAWN POSES, especially ascent arms DOWN versus fall arms UP. No attack, no weapon, no walking. All six frames exclusively belong to one jump. Keep the torso neck and waist aligned across equal cells so it can attach to separately generated head and lower body.
prompts.cape:
Strict reference/edit target is attached forest girl. Draw ONLY her dark forest-green BACK CAPE for a vertical JUMP. Six frames, EXACTLY 3 columns x 2 rows, TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no character, head, hair, arms, front skirt, belt or legs. Source chunky pixel art, dark plum outline, green leaf-shaped ragged hem, muted olive highlights. Reconstruct fabric hidden behind body.
The cape attachment is at the upper back/right shoulder: mark it by the short narrow fabric root only, NO drawn marker. The attachment must be in the SAME RELATIVE LOCATION NEAR THE CENTER OF EACH CELL, allowing the cloth to extend DOWN or UP from it. Same scale, same fabric length and volume in all cells, with generous margin.
TOP LEFT APPUI: relaxed diagonal drape DOWN and LEFT from the attachment.
TOP MIDDLE ASCENT: upward acceleration makes cape trail strongly DOWN, narrow folded vertical shape, ragged tips all pointing DOWN.
TOP RIGHT APEX: cape momentarily floats almost horizontally LEFT, loose fabric folding outward, transition toward rising.
BOTTOM LEFT FALL: downward velocity makes the entire free cloth flow UP from the shoulder attachment, hem and ragged tips ABOVE the attachment. It should fly behind and above the absent head.
BOTTOM MIDDLE FALL / WIND LEFT: still ABOVE attachment, billowing and rippling LEFT with distinct folds and hem shape.
BOTTOM RIGHT FALL / WIND RIGHT: still ABOVE attachment, billowing and rippling RIGHT, distinct alternate folds.
Bottom row must NOT show a downward hanging cape: free tips point UP; root stays at same anchor. These are hand-drawn animation poses, not rotated copies. Only this one cape, six times, faithfully matching the original material and pixel density. Absolutely no glow or soft shadows.
prompts.lower:
Edit target / identity reference: original attached red-haired forest girl. Draw a CUTOUT LOWER BODY sprite sheet for ONLY ONE VERTICAL JUMP. Six drawings in exactly 3 columns x2 rows. Transparent background, no labels/grid/glow/shadows. Include brown belt with gold buckle, side pouch, green front tabard with bottle, both thighs and both brown boots with leaf on the LEFT boot. EXCLUDE back cape, head, hair, chest, arms and hands. Preserve original costume, proportions, three-quarter facing RIGHT, chunky square pixels and dark plum outline.
Same pelvis/belt width, same leg lengths, same scale throughout. Waist anchor at same relative position in each cell; changing boot positions must be drawn, never scaling the entire sprite. Equal generous cell margins.
TOP LEFT APPUI: very clear preparatory crouch, BOTH knees bent outward, hips low relative to boots, both soles planted on a common ground line. Legs visibly compressed by bent joints, not short redesigned legs.
TOP MIDDLE ASCENT: after push-off, hips rise, knees lightly bent with lower legs trailing DOWN/back, boots toe-down; legs closer together.
TOP RIGHT APEX: knees tucked UP more strongly, boots dangling below bent knees, light weightless pose.
BOTTOM LEFT FALL: legs extend DOWN again, knees slightly flexed to prepare landing, both boot soles facing down.
BOTTOM MIDDLE FALL WIND A: same extended falling stance, one boot angles slightly outward and cloth hem ripples left.
BOTTOM RIGHT FALL WIND B: same falling stance, opposite slight boot/hem variation.
All six drawings should visibly belong to one jump, never a walk cycle. Retain pouch, bottle, leaf and costume placement. Do not add skin or remove boots.
prompts.head:
Using attached original pixel-art character as strict identity and palette reference, create ONLY THE HEAD SKIN, ear and short neck as a six-pose JUMP animation sheet. Exactly 3 columns x2 rows. No hair, flower, eyes, eyebrows, lashes, mouth, clothes or body. The face must stay BLANK so separately drawn eyes and hair can overlay it. Keep tiny original nose pixel and subtle cheek blush. Peach colors, original dark plum outline, chunky pixel geometry, three-quarter facing RIGHT. Reconstruct forehead behind the removed hair. Preserve original small face proportions: do not make a large round baby head.
Same scale and same neck anchor in all six cells, very small orientation changes to stay compatible with the same hair roots.
1 APPUI: chin lowered slightly, head preparing to jump.
2 ASCENT: chin up slightly, looking toward upward travel.
3 APEX: head balanced neutral angle.
4 FALL: chin lowered slightly, looking toward ground.
5 FALL WIND LEFT: same falling angle, tiny tilt toward left.
6 FALL WIND RIGHT: same falling angle, tiny tilt toward right.
Each pose is a new drawing with consistent face outline and ear anatomy, not transformed duplicate. Modest changes only, no profile view. Equal cell sizes and margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no glow/shadows, no labels or grids.
prompts.eyes:
Strict character reference: eyes of attached orange-haired pixel-art girl. Produce ONLY SIX PAIRS OF EYES for one jump, arranged EXACTLY 3 columns x2 rows on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No face, head, skin, hair, body, brows detached, text, grid, glow or shadows. Match original dark plum block eyes and small squared white gleams, three-quarter right perspective; left eye a little wider than right. Original chunky pixels, no smooth shapes, no extra eyelashes.
Keep centers of the two eyes, distance between eyes and outer widths CONSISTENT across all six cells. Each pair centered identically in its cell with generous margin.
1 APPUI: slightly narrowed focused eyes.
2 ASCENT: open eyes looking a little UP (gleams/pupils high).
3 APEX: wide alert eyes, neutral gaze.
4 FALL: open eyes looking a little DOWN, upper lids slightly lowered.
5 FALL WIND LEFT: narrow squint reacting to wind, both eyes still recognizable.
6 FALL WIND RIGHT: brief CLOSED-EYE blink, two simple dark plum horizontal pixel eyelids.
These are separate overlays to place on a blank skin head. Six clearly distinct expressions, not six copies of normal eyes. Render only the opaque eye pixels, no surrounding skin patches.
